title: docs(skills): name the injected owner_id as the record owner in ui, query and automation examples
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XGruGA9LzTe9xWiqzBAzg8y)_

Fixes #33560

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Signed: domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5m9ZMjU7EYnzJH8T6s

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-ui`(列表视图、动作、仪表盘)、`objectstack-query`(expand 示例)、`objectstack-automation`(notify 收件人)里把「负责人」写成 `assigned_to` / `assignee` 字段的示例,全部改成平台注入的 `owner_id`;删掉把 `assigned_to` 列标成 "Owner" 的那一列;「我的」筛选旁加一处指向 objectstack-data § Relationship Patterns 的交叉引用。eval 同步:ui 视图 eval 1、12 与 query eval 4 期望 `owner_id`;ui eval 2 的参考答案不再含有它自己 `must_not_contain` 禁止的字面量。
- 为什么改:PR #33555 已在 objectstack-data 里规定负责人 / 处理人 = `owner_id`,其它技能还在教另造一个负责人字段,同时加载的 agent 会拿到互相矛盾的教学,建出两个「负责人」列,而「我的记录」视图和按负责人可见性只读 `owner_id`。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能示例文字、eval 与一个 patch changeset,不碰 schema 与运行时;回滚即还原本 PR。五个文件 token 都没超上限、上限未动(automation 6861/6861 字节数不变)。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` 第 53、60、101 行;`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` eval 1、2、12。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -nE "assigned_to|\bassignee\b" -- 'skills/*.md'`,预期只剩 objectstack-data 的规则本身(SKILL.md 313、441 行)和 examples-objects.md 88 行的注释,以及 objectui protocol.md 300 行的 `assignee` 到 `owner_id` 映射。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`),席位的达档契约复审 PASS 记录在案后,请合并。

## What changes

Every published example that used `assigned_to` / `assignee` as the record owner beside the injected `owner_id` now names `owner_id`. Measured on `main` @ 6ff3eee7 (the card's line numbers were taken on 8e63ed87; all still hold except dashboards, now line 269):

| File | Line | Was | Now |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` | 53 | simple `columns` with `'assigned_to'` | `'owner_id'` |
| same | 60 | `{ field: 'assigned_to', label: 'Owner' }`, a second field carrying the injected owner's label | `{ field: 'owner_id' }` (its injected label is already Owner) |
| same | 101 | "mine" rule on `assigned_to`, comment glossing `{current_user_id}` | rule on `owner_id`; the comment now reads "mine: the record owner (objectstack-data § Relationship Patterns)", the one cross-reference this PR adds |
| same | 265, 270 | kanban `columns` with `'assignee'` | `'owner_id'` |
| same | 321 | gantt `columns` with `'assigned_to'` (not cited by the card, same pattern) | `'owner_id'` |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | 44 | Reassign Lead `params: [{ field: 'assigned_to' }]` | `owner_id`: reassigning a lead changes its owner |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` | 269 | metric `filter: { assignee: '{current_user_id}' }` | `owner_id` |
| `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` | 290, 292 | `fields` and `expand` on `assignee` | `owner_id`, spelled as the spec's own `expand` example (`packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts:392`, `expand: { owner_id: { object: 'user', ... } }`) |
| `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | 115 | notify `recipients` `record.assignee` | `record.owner_id` (node `tell_owner`, label "Notify Owner") |

No separate handler field was kept anywhere: in every site the example meant the owner, so no "grants no access" sentence was owed. The rule itself is not restated; the list-view comment points at objectstack-data § Relationship Patterns (the Record owner row PR #33555 added, `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:313`).

### Evals

- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` eval 1: the owner column and the `my_open` filter are `owner_id`; `must_contain` gains `owner_id`, `must_not_contain` gains `'assigned_to'` (quoted, so the "never an `assigned_to` field" prose does not trip it).
- Eval 12: the "mine" rule is `owner_id`; same two assertion additions.
- Eval 2 (scope add 6888544144): the assertion is right and the reference prose was wrong. `rules/navigation.md:39` teaches the approvals inbox gated by `requiresService: 'approvals'`, so `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'` in `must_not_contain` is correct; the `expected_output` spelled that literal inside its own "never ..." warning. It now says "never a `requiresObject` gate on `sys_approval_request`".
- `skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json` eval 4 (outside the order's named surface; covered by the ruling "any other eval answering owner with `assigned_to`"): its prompt asks for the task's assignee, which the objectstack-data rule maps to `owner_id`; it answered with an `assignee` field and would contradict the query SKILL.md example this PR changes. Now `owner_id`, `must_contain` gains `owner_id`.
- Self-check over both eval files: every `must_contain` literal occurs in its own `expected_output`, and no `must_not_contain` literal does (before: ui eval 2 hit `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'`; after: 0 hits).

### Token budget, paid in place

| File | Tokens before / after / ceiling | Bytes before / after | Lines |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` | 3446 / 3444 / 3451 | 13783 / 13776 | 334 / 334 |
| `objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | 2453 / 2452 / 2453 | 9810 / 9807 | 185 / 185 |
| `objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` | 6230 / 6230 / 6232 | 24918 / 24918 | 475 / 475 |
| `objectstack-query/SKILL.md` | 4596 / 4596 / 5547 | 18403 / 18403 | 439 / 439 |
| `objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | 6861 / 6861 / 6861 | 27464 / 27464 | 463 / 463 |

The cross-reference is paid for in list-views.md by the swaps (`assigned_to` to `owner_id` is 3 bytes shorter), the dropped redundant `label: 'Owner'`, and the `({current_user_id} = the signed-in user)` gloss, whose home is `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:205` (the token vocabulary). No ceiling moved. Package total, all eleven `skills/*/SKILL.md`: 4588 lines and 236197 bytes before and after. Eval JSON is measured, not ratcheted.

## Tests

Skill text and evals only: no package is touched, so no package test, typecheck or ablation is owed. The five edited `os:check` blocks type-check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` exit 0 ("346 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)").

## Acceptance notes

- Remaining `assignee` / `assigned_to` in published skills are correct and untouched: the objectstack-data rule itself (`SKILL.md:313`, `:441`), `references/examples-objects.md:88` (`// assignee: the injected owner_id`), objectui `rules/protocol.md:300` (maps `assignee` to `owner_id`), and the evals whose `must_not_contain` forbids `assigned_to` (data, platform, automation). `ui/skills/**`: no hit.
- The order's surface listed `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` but not its eval file; the eval edit is declared above.

## Verification

- `dispatch-gates --tier`: MANDATORY contract-review tier (`skills/**`, clause ①, no one-line exit). This thread ran on the default tier; the at-tier contract review is the seat's.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-s3x4uf`: GOVERNED, landing tier H, `skills/**` ×7, +30 / -20 over 8 files, under the human-merge threshold. The low-risk arm reads NOT MEASURED from a branch (no PR to read); `--pr` reading in the report.
- Ratchets on head 10f2b24b: `check-skills-token-ratchet` exit 0; `check-skill-line-ratchet` exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`), run on head 10f2b24b after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/lint... --filter=@objectstack/formula... --filter=@objectstack/client-react...` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0): **47 derived, 46 exit 0, 1 exit 3 NOT MEASURED** (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reads every package's `dist`; no package is touched, CI runs it). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 47 accounted for, 46 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
